v1_is_immutable: V1 remains untouched at authority/v5-masking-qualification-20260916@897bb0c1 with disposition MASKING_AUTHORITY_REMAINS_OPEN. Its interpretation is TOP_K_RECURRENCE_IS_SCALE_UNSTABLE_FOR_THIS_PURPOSE, NOT that dependency-aware masking cannot work.

target_definition.question: Can a targeted mask, discovered without touching the validation donors, prevent a completely fresh cheap attacker from finding another easy molecular reconstruction route better than an equally costly random mask?

design_defects_found_by_synthetic_testin.found: a within-donor global factor (depth, overall expression level) produced held-out R2 of 0.941 with NO planted shortcut
design_defects_found_by_synthetic_testin.why: a universal per-cell factor lifts every address including the target, so any address predicts any target
design_defects_found_by_synthetic_testin.fix: shortcut strength is measured INCREMENTALLY over a global-cell-state baseline computed from visible values only. A global cell factor IS broader cell state; the stated goal is reconstruction WITHOUT understanding broader cell state, so predicting from it is the legitimate signal, not the shortcut.

design_defects_found_by_synthetic_testin.found: operator- and source-only offsets drove baseline R2 to -22.3 and -9.0 on held-out donors, inflating the incremental gain to +22.2 and +8.9 with no shortcut planted
design_defects_found_by_synthetic_testin.why: train-fitted feature standardisation is mis-scaled on donors whose feature distribution is shifted by a batch effect
design_defects_found_by_synthetic_testin.fix: features are standardised WITHIN each donor. Lawful, because features are visible at inference and no target information is used.

design_defects_found_by_synthetic_testin.found: under a strong global factor a genuine planted shortcut scored only 0.084 raw incremental R2
design_defects_found_by_synthetic_testin.why: raw incremental R2 is normalised by total target variance, which the confound dominates
design_defects_found_by_synthetic_testin.fix: primary statistic is PARTIAL R2 = (R2_full - R2_base) / (1 - R2_base): of the variance the baseline could not explain, how much do the candidates explain?
per-donor R2 is computed on donor-centred target and donor-centred prediction, so a per-donor level offset counts neither for nor against

post_fix_synthetic_evidence.interpretation: suppression and specificity hold simultaneously; suppressing confounds is not achieved by predicting nothing

cross_fitting_design.outer_rule: deterministic source-stratified; seed = sha256(namespace|source); every donor validates exactly once
cross_fitting_design.inner_rotation: source-stratified halves of the outer-training donors; A screens -> B fits, and B screens -> A fits
cross_fitting_design.inner_combination_justification: screening is a RECALL instrument. Intersection would compound two independent recall failures and systematically drop real shortcuts, which is the exact failure mode that made historical pooled-Pearson masking worse than uniform. Union keeps a candidate discovered by either direction; the attacker, not the screen, decides what is real.
cross_fitting_design.fold_count_justification: approximately 85-104 donors across three sources; 10 folds leaves ~8-10 validation donors per fold while preserving ~90 percent of donors for discovery. A 30/30/30 split would waste NPH52, the smallest source.

screening.statistic: per-donor |Spearman| against the target, averaged with equal donor weight inside a source and equal weight across sources
screening.calibration: SYNTHETIC ONLY. Grid m in {20,40,80,160} x alpha in {1e-3,1e-2,1e-1}. Rule declared before reading results: maximise planted recall subject to null partial R2 < 0.10 on every nuisance, tie-break smallest m then largest alpha.
forbidden_inputs: hidden target values from validation donors

attacker.alpha_selection: synthetic-only calibration; no real FULL104 outcome influenced it
attacker.missing_support: address excluded where not measurable; unmeasured is never zero and never disagreement
attacker.random_state: none; no warm start, no coefficient reuse, no feature reuse beyond the lawful screening universe
attacker.escalation_forbidden: no nonlinear or neural attacker in this lane; the purpose is to detect EASY shortcuts, not to approximate JEPA capacity

primary_metric.name: FRESH_REFIT_RESIDUAL_SHORTCUT_PREDICTABILITY
primary_metric.definition: for each masking condition, instantiate a completely fresh attacker, screen and fit it from scratch on outer-training donors using ONLY addresses that remain visible, then evaluate partial R2 on outer-validation donors
primary_metric.why_not_the_frozen_attacker: deleting the features the first attacker selected and re-scoring that same attacker is close to tautological; only a fresh refit can reveal that the attacker simply found another route

secondary_metric.name: FROZEN_ATTACKER_AFTER_MASK
secondary_metric.label: SECONDARY_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY
secondary_metric.rule: a large drop here cannot qualify V2 by itself

shortcut_set_rule_frozen.ordering: candidates by screening score descending, ties by address index
shortcut_set_rule_frozen.rule: smallest prefix S whose removal reduces the cross-fitted partial R2 (measured on inner-fit donors, never on outer-validation donors) to at most 50 percent of its full-candidate value
shortcut_set_rule_frozen.no_shortcut_behaviour: if full-candidate partial R2 < 0.05 the target is declared NO_SHORTCUT and receives no augmentation; the ordinary random mask still applies
shortcut_set_rule_frozen.threshold_honesty: V2 is NOT threshold-free. These are frozen conventions chosen from synthetic reasoning, not tuned on real data.

conditions_compared_at_matched_budget.V1_CONTROL: frozen V1 top-K recurrence mask rerun at the V2 evidence budget, using the ORIGINAL V1 definition. K and R may not be changed to help it.
conditions_compared_at_matched_budget.V2: uniform mask with shortcut co-mask augmentation

matched_budget: all three conditions mask the same number of addresses
budget_authority_note: MaskingAuthorityV1 references a separate target_evidence_budget_authority. This lane does not own and does not set the production mask fraction.
power_ladder_rule: execute every level; do not stop at the first that passes

qualification_thresholds_frozen.primary: V2 must reduce fresh-refit partial R2 by at least 30 percent relative to matched-budget uniform masking
qualification_thresholds_frozen.absolute_floor: and by at least 0.02 in absolute partial R2
qualification_thresholds_frozen.justification: V1's 20 percent is NOT recycled. Partial R2 over residual variance is a more sensitive scale than V1's edge-crossing fraction, so a larger relative effect is required. Both numbers are CONVENTIONS declared before any real V2 result, chosen as substantial structural effects rather than derived from an observation.
qualification_thresholds_frozen.no_vacuous_subgroup: a subgroup with zero evaluated targets is NOT_ESTIMABLE, never PASS
qualification_thresholds_frozen.spectacular_small_n_rule: a large improvement on a handful of targets is NOT a pass

reporting_prohibition: no confidence interval may be restated as a biological claim; the question is shortcut suppression only
global_failure_conditions: no condition meets the primary threshold -> MASKING_V2_SHORTCUT_AUTHORITY_REMAINS_OPEN
any threshold changed after seeing real V2 results -> the lane is void
a vacuous subgroup reported as PASS -> the lane is void
screening planted-shortcut recall failure -> fix screening before real evaluation
